notes: Strong pool for this one. TMax has a dense cluster of sentence-transformers embed-query-cosine-topk tasks that transfer almost directly; final_top10 is 6/10 TMax by honest judgement. RTS is essentially one task family (CADE compass/slice embeddings, ~15 near-duplicate variants) plus sds-mnist, so its list is necessarily repetitive - downstream dedup may want to keep only 2-3 CADE variants. TerminalWorld is thin: only 3 instructions in the whole corpus mention similarity, so ranks 6-10 there are scored 2. SWE-Smith's only real contribution is the life4/textdistance and python-string-similarity families (similarity-metric correctness). 'result.txt' and 'top 10' (massdns Alexa top-10k in RTS) were ignored as boilerplate/false friends.
